 Scorpio Shani Horoscope Today, 13 November 2026: Mercury Turns Direct Tonight, Shani Retrograde Frees a Stuck Task 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Chinese Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Chinese Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Chinese Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Scorpio Shani Horoscope Today, 13 November 2026: Mercury Turns Direct Tonight, Shani Retrograde Frees a Stuck Task 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 13, 2026, 04:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print A job that has refused to move for weeks may finally start rolling for Scorpio. Tonight, Mercury ends its retrograde in Libra, your twelfth house of background work and pending matters. Mercury rules your eighth and eleventh houses, the zones of research, paperwork and gains. During its backward phase, a file, approval or piece of information you needed may have stayed stuck with someone else. Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your fifth house of projects, supports patient effort. From tomorrow, the task can move again. The Hold-Up Begins to Clear 
 Your own effort does not stall many stuck tasks. They wait on a reply, a signature, a password reset or a missing document from someone else. Mercury’s station tonight shifts that pattern. Emails sent tomorrow may get faster responses. Systems that kept failing could start working. Use today to prepare. Gather what you already have, so you can act quickly once the reply arrives. Shani Rewards Readiness 
 Shani in your fifth house values well-planned work. It does not reward rushing, but it does reward being ready. If you know which step comes next, write it down. If a colleague needs a reminder, draft a polite message tonight and send it tomorrow morning. Shani’s own retrograde means you still need a little patience, yet the direction now favours progress. Mars Gives You the Push 
 Mars, your ruling planet, entered Leo, your tenth house of career, last night. It now sits strong beside Jupiter and Ketu. Your confidence at work is rising. Once the stuck task moves, you will have the drive to finish it well. Venus turns direct tomorrow too, bringing support from friends and colleagues in your eleventh house. Join conversation

 The Moon Asks for Careful Words 
 The Moon moves through Sagittarius, your second house of speech, squaring Shani early in the day. Frustration may tempt you to send a sharp message. Hold back. A firm but courteous reminder works far better. Today is also Vinayaka Chaturthi, a good day to ask for obstacles to be cleared before restarting work. What to Do Today 
 List every task that has been stuck because of someone else’s delay. Gather the documents and details you already have. Draft polite follow-up messages and send them tomorrow morning after Mercury turns direct. Avoid harsh words even if you feel frustrated. Pray to Ganesha before you begin, and use Mars’s fresh strength to finish the task once it moves. Shani Remedy for Today 
 Ring a small bell at a Ganesha shrine on Chaturthi and pray for the path ahead to open. Pay a small pending fee for an elderly person’s certificate or official paperwork.
